note: These values are provisional design references, not a universal purchasable upgrade list. A Unit may purchase only upgrades specifically made available by its profile or another applicable rule. Reference costs generally assume a single Character or Model. Applying improvements to every Model in a multi-model Unit requires separate pricing.

referenceUpgrades.name: +1" Move
referenceUpgrades.description: Increase a unit's Movement by 1". Particularly valuable for mobile Units.

referenceUpgrades.name: Improve Armor
referenceUpgrades.description: Improve a single Model's Armor Save by one step. Value scales with existing Wounds and defenses.

referenceUpgrades.name: Improve Evade
referenceUpgrades.description: Improve a single Model's Evade Save by one step.

referenceUpgrades.name: Specialized Ward 6+
referenceUpgrades.description: Gain Ward 6+ against one specified Damage type.

referenceUpgrades.name: Universal Ward 6+
referenceUpgrades.description: Gain Ward 6+ against all applicable Damage types.

referenceUpgrades.name: +1 Wound
referenceUpgrades.description: Increase one Model's maximum Wounds by 1.

referenceUpgrades.name: Accurate 1
referenceUpgrades.description: Reroll up to one natural 1 during an Attack with the specified weapon.

referenceUpgrades.name: Tough 1
referenceUpgrades.description: Reroll up to one natural 1 when making Armor Saves.

referenceUpgrades.name: Brace 1
referenceUpgrades.description: Reduce incoming Impact by 1 when successfully Charged.

referenceUpgrades.name: +1 Attack
referenceUpgrades.description: Increase one Model's specified weapon Attacks by 1.

referenceUpgrades.name: Improve Hit
referenceUpgrades.description: Improve a single Model's specified Attack Hit characteristic by one step.

referenceUpgrades.name: +1 Damage
referenceUpgrades.description: Increase the Damage of one specified weapon by 1 for a single Model.

referenceUpgrades.name: +2" normal Range
referenceUpgrades.description: Extend the printed normal Range of a Unit's selected weapon by 2"; does not itself create a Long Range penalty.

referenceUpgrades.name: Minor Mobility Trait
referenceUpgrades.description: Gain a limited movement or terrain-related benefit.

referenceUpgrades.name: Concealed
referenceUpgrades.description: Gain Concealed under specified circumstances, restricting ordinary targeting.

referenceUpgrades.name: Pinpoint
referenceUpgrades.description: Ignore the normal Hit penalty when attacking an enemy Engaged with another Unit.

referenceUpgrades.name: Critical 1
referenceUpgrades.description: Convert up to one failed Hit die into a Critical Hit after rerolls; no Surge is required. Bypasses Armor and Evade; Ward applies.

referenceUpgrades.name: Anti-[Type] 1
referenceUpgrades.description: Increase the weapon's Attacks by 1 against the specified Unit category.

referenceUpgrades.name: Weapon Specialization (Anti-[Type] 2, Unit-wide, choice of tag)
referenceUpgrades.description: See Weapon Specialization on individual Unit profiles: a broader, Unit-wide version applicable once to a multi-Model formation's combined Attack pool.

referenceUpgrades.name: Minor Passive Ability
referenceUpgrades.description: Gain one narrowly defined passive battlefield benefit.

referenceUpgrades.name: Strong Passive Ability
referenceUpgrades.description: Gain a substantial passive ability requiring individual balance review.

referenceUpgrades.name: Additional Command
referenceUpgrades.description: Learn another eligible Command Ability without increasing CP or available Doctrine cards.
